notes.title: New Update Available!
notes.content:
Released patch v1.1:

Dear players, today we launch the first patch of Shiny.

- Improved gamepad control. Players can now land when speeding up and better accuracy.
- Fix: "Super Shiny" achievement can't be unlocked (thanks to nekojita and ChBlack for reporting this)
- Fix: The game can't be played with mouse when a game controller is plugged (thanks to Louna and rhywun for reporting this)
- Fix: Minor fixes in english language.
